head.title: AI Desktop Studio — Imagine. Generate. Create.
head.description: Multimodal desktop application: image, video, 3D, audio, textures and skyboxes in a dockable panel interface. Offline dictation and control through an MCP server.
head.ogTitle: AI Desktop Studio — Imagine. Generate. Create.
head.ogDescription: Six generation workshops in a single window. Electron, React 19, TypeScript. macOS, Windows, Linux.

hero.lede: From images to sound, video to 3D. Generate and refine your creations in one project.

home.title: Your ideas take shape here.
home.lede: Keep images, sounds, scenes and references in one project. Switch workshops, arrange your panels and keep your files in open formats.
home.alt: Home screen: a banner to resume the last project, a list of recently opened projects, shortcuts to the six workshops, a feed of creations published by everyone, and the account library panel.

0.title: A workshop for every medium
0.text: Image, video, audio, 3D, materials and skies. Extend your scenes with scripts in the Code workspace.

1.title: Your project’s thread
1.text: Share references and instructions with generation tools and the assistant, without repeating them for every attempt.

2.title: Files that stay open
2.text: OpenRaster, OpenTimelineIO, glTF and MaterialX keep your creations readable beyond the studio.

video.lede: Two monitors, a multitrack timeline, and models that produce the shots.

0.text: Source and Program, as on an editing station: the chosen clip on one side, the edit as it will be exported on the other.

1.text: Video and audio tracks, selection, blade and hand tools, timecoded playback.

2.text: Create shots with the available models, then assemble your media in the edit.

video.alt: Video workshop: Source and Program monitors side by side, Assets panel, clip inspector, four-track timeline V1, A1, V2 and A2.

threeD.lede: Compose a scene. Animate a character. Put your ideas in motion.

0.text: Prepare skeletons, adjust rigs, reuse animations and combine movement states in a dedicated workshop.

1.text: Compose scenes, sculpt terrain and work on materials, lighting and effects.

2.text: Add scripts and use a gamepad. Try your scene’s behaviors without leaving the studio.

threeD.alt: 3D workshop: a generated car placed in a mountain setting, move gizmo and triangle counter overlaid, scene tree and inspector on the right, light timeline at the bottom.

image.lede: Generate an image. Select what matters. Refine it, layer by layer.

0.text: Choose a suitable local or remote model, then generate and refine your image in the studio.

1.text: Local smart selection finds a region from a point or rectangle, ready for editing.

2.text: Layers, masks, brushes, text and pixel art. Manual tools and models complement each other.

image.alt: Image workshop: a transparent canvas with a cut-out skeleton, model catalogue on the left, Layers and Inspector panels on the right, asset strip at the bottom.

audio.lede: Compose and edit sound across several tracks, in the same window as the rest.

0.text: Multitrack editing, the same tools as the video timeline, playback locked to the same timecode.

1.text: Computed in a separate process: an hour of sound does not freeze the interface while it is analysed.

2.text: Music, ambiences and effects, generated by the API then dropped straight onto a track.

audio.alt: Audio workshop: Program monitor showing the waveform of the edit, Source monitor below, catalogue of sound generation models, four-track audio timeline.

textures.lede: A material, not an image: each channel is produced then checked separately.

0.text: Inspect and edit color, normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion, height, emission and cavity channels.

1.text: The material is applied to a test volume — sphere, cube, cylinder, plane, knot — and lit in real time, before export.

2.text: Check tiling and seams, then export your maps to the tools that need them.

textures.alt: Materials workshop: preview cube carrying the material, inspector open on the channels — base colour and normal — then on the material settings, strip of generated images.

skyboxes.lede: A sky that serves as a backdrop and, at the same time, as a light source.

0.text: 360°, equirectangular, cross, six faces. Switch from one view to another without re-exporting.

1.text: Adjustable field of view and test objects, to judge the light on a matte sphere and a glossy one.

2.text: The sky produced here lights the 3D workshop scene directly.

skyboxes.alt: Skyboxes workshop: a snowy mountain sky in 360-degree projection, two test spheres on the ground — one matte, one mirror — and sun settings on the right.

architecture.title: AI on your terms.
architecture.lede: Choose models for what you want to create. Local or cloud, the tools stay together in one studio.

0.title: Your workspace
0.text: Arrange panels and tabs, or detach them into another window. Each workshop remembers its layout for the next session.

1.title: Return to your work
1.text: Documents rebuild from their saved state, including in detached panels. The same foundation supports saving and undo.

2.title: Project folder
2.text: Browse files even without the studio. Manage versions, branches and conflicts with Git. Import, export and the library find the same media, even after moves outside the app.

3.title: Settings for your chosen model
3.text: Find each model’s options in one panel, for every kind of generation.

4.title: Keep your attempts in view
4.text: Follow your generations and find their results alongside other media in your project.

5.title: Keys separate from the interface
5.text: The system encrypts your keys. The interface receives connection status without receiving secrets.

6.title: Models on your machine
6.text: Download and manage compatible models. Availability depends on the operation, model and your computer’s resources.

7.title: The studio is driven from outside
7.text: Documents, images, scenes, animation, settings and files: connect an external assistant to the studio’s published MCP actions.

8.title: Background processing
8.text: Thumbnails, waveforms, heavy geometry and video encoding use the GPU or tasks separate from the interface.

aiModels.intro: Create an image, animate a character, dictate an idea or ask for help. Choose the right model for each task, on your computer or remotely.
aiModels.cloudIntro: Your accounts, keys and models. Generation and the assistant each keep their own model choice.
aiModels.scenarioDescription: Create and transform images, videos, audio, 3D models, materials and skyboxes. The studio shows the models available to your account and the settings for each generation.
aiModels.tripoDescription: Turn text, an image or multiple views into 3D. Texture, refine, stylize, segment or simplify a mesh; prepare its rig and animations. Generate and edit the source images too.
aiModels.assistantTitle: Your assistant, with the provider you choose.
aiModels.assistantDescription: Conversation, creative help and scripting. Image analysis depends on the selected model.
aiModels.cloudNote: The cloud catalogue changes with services and account permissions. Each provider’s credits and terms apply.
aiModels.localIntro: Every use, every model: the complete local catalogue.
aiModels.assistantUse: Chat, understand a request and prepare actions in the studio.
aiModels.codeUse: Write and revise scripts for your scenes.
aiModels.imagesUse: Generation, editing, inpainting, outpainting, references and guidance. Compatible models also support materials.
aiModels.cutoutUse: Isolate a region from a point or rectangle, then refine its mask.
aiModels.videoUse: Create from text, animate an image or transform a video, depending on the model.
aiModels.musicUse: Create or transform music; generate sound to accompany a video.
aiModels.threeDUse: Turn text or an image into a 3D model, then modify its geometry.
aiModels.skyUse: Create a panoramic environment from text or an image.
aiModels.rigUse: Automatically prepare a character’s skeleton and skinning weights.
aiModels.memoryUse: Retrieve the meaning of your conversations and stored information.
aiModels.motionUse: Generate motion from text. Listed in the catalogue; download blocked, user import required.
aiModels.dictationUse: Turn speech into text without sending audio to the cloud.
aiModels.ownTitle: Ollama and your own GGUF files.
aiModels.ownDescription: Find your compatible Ollama models or import a GGUF file for the assistant. You control which model is used.
aiModels.localNote: Local models require installation. Availability depends on the engine, memory and hardware; each model has its own licence. Kimodo is listed but its download is blocked. AI upscaling and vectorization currently have no declared engine in this catalogue.
